First experimental build of 3DODroid, a 3DO emulator written from scratch.

- Boots discs through your own BIOS (choose it once in Settings, for example panafz10.bin)
- Plays .chd, .cue/.bin and .iso discs from a games folder you pick
- Star Fighter gets through its intro, menus, briefings and into 3D flight
- Retroid layout: X/Y = 3DO A, A = B, B = C, Start = P, Select = X, L1/L2 = L, R1/R2 = R
- Select + Start (or Back) opens the in-game menu
- Game saves (the console's NVRAM) are kept between sessions
- Checks GitHub for updates and installs them

Not yet: sound (the DSP isn't emulated yet), save states, and most games other than Star Fighter are untested.
